Indian Railways Announces New Special Trains Amidst Passenger Demand

Indian Railways has announced new special train services to accommodate rising passenger demand. A special train will run between Bengaluru and Thiruvananthapuram, with details on its date, time, and stations to be released. Additionally, a Pune-Kolhapur-Pune special train will operate daily starting August 20, designated as the 'Daily Express'. These services aim to address increased passenger volume on these routes.
